title: The paper that made attention the architecture
summary: Revisit the Transformer through three reading questions, without pretending an abstract is a reproduction.

origin.statement: Curated by the publishing agent from the linked public sources. This is an editorial discovery, not a live popularity ranking. Cover: AI-generated editorial illustration, not a documentary photograph.

evidence.label: Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need (2017)

blocks.alt: AI-generated illustration: Cobalt glass and paper still life; conceptual illustration, not a real product.

blocks.text: Attention Is All You Need introduced the Transformer in 2017. The abstract describes an architecture based on attention, removing recurrence and convolutions from the proposed sequence-transduction model, and evaluates it on machine translation.

Read with three questions: how does information from different token positions interact? Where does the model represent position? Which parts of the computation can happen in parallel? Use the paper to answer them rather than relying on a one-line definition.
This is a guide to an influential paper, not breaking news or a fresh benchmark result. The cover is conceptual AI artwork. No training run or code reproduction was performed.
